name: com.kashrock/kashrock-mcp
title: KashRock MCP
description: Esports props, odds, live scores, and player stats across 8 titles for agents.

environmentVariables.name: KASHROCK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: KashRock API key. Optional — skips the login tool's Google sign-in flow by supplying an existing key directly.

auth.description: initialize and tools/list require no authentication. Data tools call the live KashRock API and return a plain-English "not signed in" result until the login tool (Google OAuth device flow) or KASHROCK_API_KEY supplies a key.
